title: Conservation floor result, version 1
description: The published result of the curation signer's conservation-floor check of one package item, carried in the conservationFloor member (an array of these) of its CURATION_EVIDENCE document. Only a passing check is published. A promise-card reader uses it only when it names the work's item hash and the declarations file the card found. Rules: docs/spec/declarations-and-conventions.md (DCL-5, DCL-33).

itemHash.description: The package item's hash, as 6529 Stream stores it (coreOf).

declarationsFileId.description: The declarations file the check read, or null when the item lists none.

then.description: With no declarations file no fact is met or waived; generative is not_applicable for a work that is not generative.

else.description: With a declarations file every fact the check applied is met or waived.
